title: A queued prompt's row is drawn in colour, not dimmed
body:
A prompt sent during a turn waits in a row above the working line, drawn by `waiting_lines` in `ui.rs` as `queued  <first line>`, with the whole row in the muted colour. Jack found it easy to miss.

## Proposal

The `queued` label is drawn in the palette's `accent`, and the prompt's text in the foreground colour. The `+ N more queued` row takes the same colours.

## Open

- The Claude adapter hands a queued prompt to Claude mid-turn, with the next tool result, but coax keeps showing the row until the whole turn ends (see the memory `claude-adapter-queues-prompts`). Whether the label should say something other than `queued` once that is known is a separate question, since coax gets no message when Claude takes the prompt.
